states.NOT REQUESTED: Initial planning state. No authorized request has been issued.
states.REQUESTED: An authorized request was actually issued and logged.
states.SUPPLIED: A specific evidence record was actually received and logged.
states.INCOMPLETE: Material fields, pages, issuer or linkage are missing.
states.UNDER REVIEW: A designated reviewer is assessing the actual submission.
states.NEEDS QUALIFIED REVIEW: Applicability, authority or terms need qualified assessment.
states.ACCEPTED AS EVIDENCE: Authorized reviewer recorded sufficient evidence for a specified purpose and scope.
states.REJECTED AS INSUFFICIENT: Authorized reviewer recorded the unresolved deficiency and reason.

proposed_steps: Identify evidence and map it to request and asset IDs
Log supplied record and custody metadata
Route unresolved questions to qualified review where needed
Record authorized acceptance or rejection with scope and reasons
Seek separate authority for any governance update
decision_boundary: Evidence acceptance is scoped to the reviewed record. Legal clearance, governance changes and production approval require their own decisions. Preserve history and create a new review record for a superseding submission.
